findings.F1: The tested move is on the predicted side but small at the plan's 5-day horizon: +0.38 % per case (t 1.04, 3360 cases on 1136 days), with a strength of 0.026. It grows steadily with the horizon: −0.06 % over 1 day (t −0.44), +1.08 % over 10 days (t 2.00, 3222 cases, 1089 days) and +1.92 % over 20 days (t 2.16, 2931 cases, 997 days), where the strength reaches 0.068. The test therefore measured the idea at a horizon shorter than the one where it shows.
findings.F2: The 20-day move is not just the 30-day-up regime itself. All non-overlapping grid points with a positive 30-day return earn only +0.72 % unusual over 20 days (t 0.32, 503 points) and +0.87 % over 10 days (t 0.80), against +1.92 % and +1.08 % after the streak cases.
findings.F3: The effect shows only when the coin's 60-day return is also positive. There the cases earn +4.41 % unusual over 20 days (t 2.63, 927 cases, 325 days) and +1.95 % over 10 days (t 2.05, 1149 cases, 400 days). With a negative 60-day return they earn −1.50 % over 20 days (t −0.79, 328 cases) and +0.44 % over 10 days (t 0.41).
findings.F4: The grading on streak length is weak at every horizon tested. The day-clustered slope of the unusual move on the forecast has t 1.32 at 5 days, 0.65 at 10 days and −0.18 at 20 days, and stays at t 0.95 over 20 days inside the 60-day-up cases. The 5-day forecast quintiles rise only loosely, from −0.03 % to +0.90 % (top quintile t 1.38). The raw streak-ratio terciles over 10 days read −0.23 %, +2.08 % (t 2.76) and +1.38 % (t 1.74).
findings.F5: Much of what drowns the effect is the market's own years. The 20-day unusual move after cases is −17.1 % in 2018 (t −6.64) and −5.7 % in 2022 (t −3.35), the bear years. It is positive in 2020 (+8.1 %, t 3.19), 2023 (+4.4 %, t 2.86) and 2024 (+4.6 %, t 2.05). It is positive on 16 of 18 coins with cases.
findings.F6: The test already used all available data: all 19 coins and folds A–D. So a rerun on more data is not possible, and the answer is to move the test to where the effect shows. Over 20 days a case's unusual move of +1.92 % (+4.41 % with a rising 60-day trend) is many times the 0.22 % cost of a trade.

ideas.idea: The more days in a row a coin has closed higher, measured against the lengths of its own up-close streaks over the past 365 days, the more it keeps rising over the next 20 days, only while its 30-day return is positive.
ideas.consequence: A trader would hold a long taken on an unusually long up streak in a rising month for about four weeks rather than five days, since the continuation builds over the longer horizon.
ideas.name: up-streak continuation over 20 days

ideas.idea: The more days in a row a coin has closed higher, measured against the lengths of its own up-close streaks over the past 365 days, the more it keeps rising over the next 20 days, only while its 30-day return is positive and its 60-day return is positive.
ideas.consequence: A trader would lean long into an unusually long up streak only when the coin is up over both the past month and the past two months, and refuse it when the two-month trend is down.
ideas.name: up-streak continuation in two-month uptrend
